content.overview: Lena set out to smash the traditional CEO mold. This brand identity was designed to empower rebels—no matter their race or gender—to rise, lead, and rewrite the rules.
content.challenge: CEO Rising®, a New York-based business accelerator led by visionary strategist Lena West, teamed up with me to lead a full brand revolution. We kicked off with deep discovery sessions that uncovered sharp insights about the business, the industry, and the brand’s bigger mission.
content.solution: Lena doesn't follow trends—she questions them. And the brand had to do the same. While most accelerators play it safe, we designed a visual language that zags where others zig. After three high-impact discovery sessions and a strategy rooted in Design Thinking, we landed on a brand that challenges convention at every touchpoint—loudly and proudly.
